# Supabase browser client

Vendored unchanged from the official `@supabase/supabase-js` npm distribution,
version **2.119.0**, which the app's former floating `@2` URL served on
2026-11-18. This removes a CDN dependency during startup and offline installation.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.119.0/dist/umd/supabase.js
License: `supabase-LICENSE` (MIT).

SHA-256 of `supabase-2.119.0.js`:
`a867edbcfb029370aeec7223dd6180b560b621fbe3bc64c6584fb0369d1b7bce`

When upgrading, use a new versioned filename, preserve the license, update this
checksum and both HTML/worker asset lists, and run startup/auth/offline tests.
